title: devexp-standup-2026-04-29
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Ben, Marta, Kofi, Lena, +2 (async)

Agenda:
- Quick sync on SDK releases (Python + Node)
- Docs quickstarts + migration guide updates
- Samples and reference apps status (chat streaming, function-calls)
- CI/e2e flakiness and release gating
- Blockers / action items

Notes:
1) SDK releases
- Python SDK 0.9.0 (beta) rollout: release branch cut last night. Main changes: streaming iterator refactor, improved reconnect logic for flaky websockets, and new helper for structured output mapping. Ben verified unit tests; integration tests failing intermittently in CI (see linked PR).
- Node SDK 1.4.2: fixes for TypeScript types and function-calling payload. Marta to publish patch once node e2e passes.
- Backwards compatibility: we still need a short migration snippet for the streaming iterator API TODO in docs.

2) Docs & Quickstarts
- Quickstart set: python-chat, node-embeddings, and rust-llm-sample (community contributed). Lena completed first drafts for python-chat and node-embeddings; awaiting final code samples from SDK teams.
- Migration guide: draft in confluence (linked). Need one-liner compatibility notes for each breaking change in SDKs. Target: publish on docs site by 2026-05-05.
- Docs staging: images and screenshots outdated for new console UI. Kofi to capture fresh screenshots this Friday.

3) Samples / Reference Apps
- Chat streaming demo: Kent has basic demo working with new streaming iterator, but saw occasional token duplication when reconnecting mid-stream. Root cause likely in reconnect state handling in runtime; filing SDK bug. (SDK-147)
- Function calling sample: updated to show structured output mapping; tests cover typical success paths but not partial failures add test coverage.
- Embeddings quickstart: updated README and small benchmark script; need to standardize metric output format (CSV -> JSON).

4) CI / e2e tests
- Flakiness: Python integration tests failing ~1/10 runs due to race in mock server teardown. Ben and QA are pairing to stabilize mock lifecycle.
- Nightly smoke: we will add a short smoke test that hits the hosted API (non-prod token) to validate basic generate/stream endpoints. Runs between 2-3am PT.

5) Roadmap sync / upcoming dates
- Target SDK stable cut: 2026-05-06 (to align with product rollout for streaming feature flag)
- Docs publish window: 2026-05-05 to allow content review and final screenshots

Blockers:
- Runtime reconnect behavior causing token duplication in streaming demo (blocking final integration test). Owner: Ben / Runtime team contact: @runtime-oncall.
- Staging docs still point at old console screens; need Kofi screenshots to finish. Owner: Kofi.

Action items:
- Ben: Continue debug on integration test flakiness, push fix or mitigation by 2026-04-30. Linked ticket: SDK-147.
- Marta: Publish Node SDK patch after e2e passes, target 2026-04-30. Add migration note to CHANGELOG.
- Lena: Finalize quickstart pages and upload code samples to docs repo by 2026-05-03.
- Kofi: Capture and upload new console screenshots by 2026-05-01.
- Aisha: Coordinate docs publish and verification once screenshots + samples in. Create PR for staging by 2026-05-04.
- QA: Add nightly smoke test for basic generate/stream endpoints; own by 2026-05-02.

Parking lot / future topics:
- Consider adding a small "cost per token" example in quickstarts to demonstrate Redwood Optimize recommendations.
- Evaluate whether streaming iterator API should include a built-in de-duplication helper for reconnects.

Misc notes / shoutouts:
- Thanks to Marta for fast turnaround on the TypeScript fixes.
- Community contributed Rust sample looks promising; need to add to CI as an optional job.

Next standup: 2026-05-06 (same time).
